lede.zh: 这份报告记录 Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct 在 3×A100-80G、vLLM-Omni 0.24.0 上的语音实时性与文本服务表现。官方 omni bench 口径下，RTF 在 C32 为 0.54，C64 升至 1.24；文本输出吞吐测至 C16，尚未达到饱和。
lede.en: This report measures Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct on 3× A100-80G with vLLM-Omni 0.24.0. Under the official omni-bench profile, RTF is 0.54 at C32 and rises to 1.24 at C64. Text output throughput was measured through C16 and had not saturated.

snapshot.zh: 官方 Omni Bench + 固定朗读 prompt · 语音实时性 / 文本吞吐 / 语音输出额外耗时
snapshot.en: Official Omni Bench + fixed read-aloud prompt · audio real-time behavior / text throughput / audio output overhead

sections.zh: 固定 prompt 语音负载

stats.zhLabel: 文本 + 语音额外耗时

heading.zh: 语音实时性与文本吞吐是两条独立曲线
heading.en: Audio real-time behavior and text throughput are separate curves

intro.zh: 官方 omni bench 下，语音 RTF 随并发上升，在 C32 仍低于 1，C64 超过 1。文本吞吐随并发增长到 C16 的 139.7 tok/s，测试范围内尚未见顶；TTFT P95 在 C16 增至 357 ms，提示排队开始。
intro.en: Under the official omni-bench profile, audio RTF rises with concurrency, remains below 1 at C32, and exceeds 1 at C64. Text throughput grows to 139.7 tok/s at C16 without reaching a measured peak; TTFT P95 reaches 357 ms at C16, indicating emerging queueing.

note.zh: 语音结论以官方 omni bench 为主口径。固定朗读 prompt 是较重的独立脚本，实时上限更保守；两者的 prompt、采集方法不同，不合并成一条曲线。
note.en: The official omni-bench results are the primary audio reference. The fixed read-aloud prompt is a separate, heavier client script with a more conservative real-time boundary. Its prompt and collection method differ, so the two are not combined into one curve.

heading.zh: 官方口径下，C32 实时，C64 首次越过 RTF=1
heading.en: Under the official profile, C32 remains real-time; C64 crosses RTF=1

intro.zh: 使用 vLLM bench serve --omni，报告并发、请求速率、Audio TTFP 与 Audio RTF。实时定义为 RTF < 1。
intro.en: Measured concurrency, request rate, Audio TTFP, and Audio RTF with vLLM bench serve --omni. Real-time is defined as RTF < 1.

hint.zh: RTF < 1 表示生成速度快于音频播放时长。
hint.en: RTF < 1 means generation completes faster than playback duration.

notes.zh: C32 的观测 RTF 为 0.54，C64 为 1.24；C64 请求速率也从 C32 的 0.61 req/s 回落到 0.53 req/s。此边界只适用于该模型、硬件与服务配置。
notes.en: Observed RTF is 0.54 at C32 and 1.24 at C64; request rate also falls from 0.61 req/s at C32 to 0.53 req/s at C64. This boundary applies only to the measured model, hardware, and serving setup.

heading.zh: 更重的固定朗读脚本在 C8 全部实时，C16 出现尾部超时
heading.en: The heavier fixed read-aloud script stays real-time through C8; its tail crosses the limit at C16

intro.zh: 每个并发点请求约 6 秒生成音频，表中列出 RTF 中位数、最大值以及是否所有观测请求均低于 1。
intro.en: Each concurrency point requests about six seconds of generated audio. The table reports median and maximum RTF and whether all observed requests stayed below 1.

title.zh: 固定 prompt · RTF 中位数与最大值
title.en: Fixed prompt · median and maximum RTF

hint.zh: 此脚本比 omni bench 更重，勿与官方工具的测点混算。
hint.en: This client script is heavier than omni bench; do not pool its points with the official-tool results.

notes.zh: 固定 prompt 口径下，C8 最大 RTF 为 0.76；C16 中位数仍低于 1，但最大值升到 1.48，因此严格按“所有请求实时”定义时，上限落在 C8。
notes.en: For the fixed-prompt profile, maximum RTF is 0.76 at C8. The C16 median remains below 1, but its maximum reaches 1.48; under the strict all-requests-real-time criterion, the boundary is C8.

heading.zh: 文本吞吐到 C16 仍增长，尾延迟已开始抬升
heading.en: Text throughput keeps rising through C16 as tail latency begins to increase

intro.zh: 流式文本请求在并发 1–16 测量 TTFT、TTFT P95、端到端耗时与输出吞吐。
intro.en: Streaming text requests were measured at concurrency 1–16 for TTFT, TTFT P95, end-to-end time, and output throughput.

hint.zh: 最大测点 C16 尚未饱和，不代表吞吐峰值。
hint.en: The highest measured point, C16, had not saturated and is not a throughput peak.

notes.zh: 同一 prompt、C8 下，纯文本 E2E P50 为 0.56 s，text+audio 为 3.88 s，语音输出额外耗时约 3.3 s。
notes.en: With the same prompt at C8, text-only E2E median is 0.56 s and text+audio is 3.88 s, an added audio-output cost of about 3.3 s.

meta.value: Thinker 1 GPU · Talker 2 replicas · Code2Wav 2 replicas

methodIntro.zh: 测试包含官方 vLLM omni bench 的实时音频矩阵、固定约 6 秒音频 prompt 的客户端 RTF 测量，以及独立的文本并发矩阵。每组测试前预热；报告采用客户端可观测指标。
methodIntro.en: The study includes the official vLLM omni-bench real-time audio matrix, a client-side RTF sweep with a fixed ~6-second audio prompt, and a separate text concurrency matrix. Each group was warmed up; reported metrics are client-observed.

methodNotes.zh: 语音 RTF 与 Audio TTFP 属于生成式音频指标，不能与普通文本 tok/s 混为一谈。固定 prompt 和官方 omni bench 的 prompt 与采集工具不同，分别呈现。
methodNotes.en: Audio RTF and Audio TTFP are generative-audio metrics and should not be conflated with text tok/s. The fixed prompt and official omni-bench profiles use different prompts and collection tools and are reported separately.

methodNotes.zh: 该报告是单实例基线，不覆盖多实例扩展或长上下文压力。Thinker 使用单卡；改变阶段副本数或启停 CUDA Graph、async chunk 会改变性能。
methodNotes.en: This is a single-instance baseline and does not cover multi-instance scaling or long-context stress. Thinker uses one GPU; changing stage replicas or CUDA Graph/async-chunk settings changes performance.
